plot_events: Guards or soldiers in a throne room notice an unusual substance on the stairs, identified as melted glass.
A giant spider-like entity descends from the dome overhead, prompting a warning shout.
A bald man linked to the spider-like mount confronts the assembled group and accuses them of cowardice for considering surrender.
The bald intruder asks why he was not called after the fleet's failure.
The group answers that they deliberately excluded him because he is 'not a Metabaron.'
They claim one of his ant-robots is their spy and exposed his secret.
The intruder is dismissed and told to leave.

visual_summary: In a large ceremonial hall with stairs leading to twin thrones beneath a dome, armed figures notice a puddle of melted glass on the steps. A giant spider-like machine or creature drops from the dome into the chamber while a bald man riding or associated with it denounces the crowd as cowards. In the lower panels, the bald figure angrily demands why he was not summoned, and the armed group replies that he is not a true Metabaron because one of his ant-robots betrayed him and revealed his secret, then orders him to leave.
